key_insight: Read-only SQL access to structured perovskite device records raised quantitative question-answering accuracy to about 51%, versus 16–23% for passage retrieval.
engineering_relevance: Reliable literature-scale comparisons of solar-cell measurements require structured experimental data, not text retrieval alone.
method: Compute 755 ground-truth answers from 45,441 measured device records.
Benchmark six retrieval architectures using an open 14B model on one 24 GB GPU.
Compare passage retrieval with read-only SQL queries over a structured device table.
evidence_signal: Evaluation covered 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers; SQL-enabled accuracy reached 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature.
watch_item: SQL-enabled accuracy remained near 51%, and deployment depends on accurate extraction and maintenance of structured device records.
paper_title: Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics
